issue_request: FHIR-46350 was Applied as Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked FHIR-I to make common/preferred plus required/maximum binding patterns consistent by deprecating the maximum additional binding purpose as equivalent to required, adding a best-practice ElementDefinition warning with the text "Required bindings SHOULD appear as the primary binding" when a context-free required additional binding is used while the primary binding is not required, and documenting how multiple required bindings can apply to CodeableConcept or CodeableReference.
initial_application: Commit 8e42147627f implemented the substantive source changes in a commit whose message included '+ FHIR-46350'. It marked maximum deprecated in the Additional Binding Purpose code system, added the ElementDefinition FHIRPath predicate, and inserted terminology-page prose for multiple required bindings. The remaining gap was that the warning diagnostic did not use the approved Jira text and the associated guidance had a typo and still referred to a max value set.
